async def _prove_one_keyspace(manager, client) -> None: """Prove the test client and the application cache manager see the SAME keys. F3.

The manager's proxies swallow every exception and return `None`/`False` (`backend_app/core/cache/redis_manager.py`, `get`/`set`/`delete`), so a cache fault and an empty keyspace are indistinguishable from the return value alone. Checking the write result first keeps the two apart instead of blaming the wrong thing.
